summary: North American Construction Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting voting results of its annual and special meeting on May 20, 2026. The items voted on include election of directors, appointment of KPMG LLP as auditors, a non-binding advisory vote on executive compensation, and ratification of an Advance Notice Bylaw. All proposals passed with substantial shareholder support. This is a routine foreign private issuer report of meeting outcomes, not a special situation. The filing contains no event categorized under any special-situations heading.
